verdict.rationale: Windows documents public programming interfaces: Win32, C++/WinRT, Rust via windows-rs, the Windows App SDK, and Windows AI APIs for Copilot+ PCs. However, these docs are framed around building apps on Windows, not around a client programmatically driving or automating the OS. The PowerShell scripting overview points to a scriptable surface, but the pack contains no API reference for controlling the system. missing for 10: documented automation/control API for driving the OS itself (e.g. UI automation or system-management API reference), machine-readable API spec, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-style programmatic control.
